promise: Change the language without losing the application.
audience: Developers rebuilding a whole application in another language or runtime.
trigger: Use when behavior, data, interfaces, and deployment must survive a whole-app migration.

modes.name: Inventory
modes.when: The source app must become a rebuildable specification.
modes.output: Observed surfaces, sequenced story cards, data/interface contracts, and acceptance criteria.

modes.name: Rebuild
modes.when: A story’s prerequisites and acceptance are known.
modes.output: An idiomatic vertical slice with unit and real-surface evidence.

modes.name: Verify
modes.when: Builder-created checks need an independent challenge.
modes.output: Source-derived parity findings, bounded reopen decisions, and retained unresolved cases.

examples.title: Preserve the failure path too
examples.brief: A fictional terminal editor is migrating languages; its save dialog preserves an unsaved buffer after a write failure.
examples.before: Translate the save function and count a successful unit test as parity.
examples.after: Observe the source failure state, put buffer preservation and recovery in the story, write the terminal probe first, then implement in target idioms.
examples.why: The observable contract includes failures, state, and recovery—not the source language’s line structure.

boundaries: The source remains read-only. Keep data migration and rollback explicit; code parity alone cannot establish data safety.
The optional Gene-Migration graph, ledger, Forge tool, and Amplifier are not required to install this method.
A ledger fitness curve measures declared completion, not independently established behavioral parity.

verification.name: Ledger ratchet and sequence detector
verification.evidence: Builder/verifier state regressions rejected and synthetic fixture curve read. These are fixture mechanics, not an app migration or behavioral parity measurement.
verification.expected: The stated scope passes; no broader result inferred.

verification.name: Executable graph syntax
verification.command: dot -Tsvg pipelines/inventory.dot -o /dev/null; dot -Tsvg pipelines/migrate.dot -o /dev/null; dot -Tsvg pipelines/verify.dot -o /dev/null
verification.evidence: All three retained graphs parse. No graph/orchestration changes or paid pipeline execution.
verification.expected: The stated scope passes; no broader result inferred.

verification.name: Portable packaging and install
verification.command: python3 scripts/capability.py build; python3 scripts/capability.py check; python3 scripts/capability.py doctor; python3 scripts/capability.py install --dest <temporary-parent> (twice)
verification.expected: Byte-identical canonical ZIP and isolated idempotent install.
verification.evidence: All operations passed. No runtime activation or effectiveness measured.

verification.name: Skill discovery metadata
verification.expected: Valid required frontmatter, naming, and complete scaffold.
verification.evidence: Skill is valid. This is a structural check, not a behavioral benchmark.

sources.role: Primary history and engine retained; methods consolidated behind the canonical portable entry.

evidence_summary: This local candidate preserves the original source and evaluation assets. Packaging and native software checks are recorded separately from comparative usefulness. No outside-user outcome or renamed-method effectiveness claim is established.
publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.
